plan.question: Can a training-only depth interpolation reference predict new intermediate geometries more reliably than the frozen FNO?
plan.data_roles: Current -2/0/+2 diagnostic physical labels become explicit training references. New -1/+1 labels are frozen prospective development validation, not independent final test.
plan.fixed: Same449-cell support, source0, float32 stencil,24receivers,2000times, frozen width8, IEEE policy, background and normalization. No fitting/training/calibration.
plan.only_main_axis: Depth of supplied material support; geometry and contrast are known forward inputs, no blind localization.
plan.linear_rule: For -1 use .5*F(-2)+.5*F(0); for +1 use .5*F(0)+.5*F(+2). Interpolate physical training scattered field snapshots and full-resolution receiver traces separately. Weights from known input depth; freeze before new labels. No interpolation of validation labels.
plan.nearest_rule: Nearest training depth; on ties choose smaller signed depth (-2 for -1,0 for +1). Fixed before labels.
plan.representation_boundary: Direct full-time physical training-trace interpolation is a simple reference with stored receiver traces, not identical to the FNO field/time reconstruction representation. Also reconstruct the interpolated training snapshots at receivers and report that variant; never hide this asymmetry.
metrics: Allmethods complete/scattered field and receiver relativeL2 separately at both states
Finite symmetric depth response between+1/-1 versus physical, relative error/norm ratio/cosine
No material recovery or speed claim
plan.screens: For each method both states scatter field and receiver<=.20 and receiver response error<=.20 with cosine>=.90; inherited engineering screens, no retuning. Report continuous errors and comparisons even on failure.

decisions.linear_passes_and_beats_network_both: Use the cheap local depth reference as current baseline; network geometry coverage remains plausible but neural necessity is absent here. Only then consider paired same-architecture coverage intervention if needed.
decisions.both_fail: Do not infer capacity failure; discrete depth response may be nonlinear over this spacing. Next isolate reference spacing/coverage before training.
decisions.network_passes_linear_fails: Earlier +/-2 failure is scale-limited locally; preregister finer depth-family response checks before inversion.
decisions.mixed: Local/directional evidence only; no broad success. Freeze results and select one discriminating follow-up.
decisions.controls_fail_or_response_small: Inconclusive; audit implementation or response scale.

plan.checks: New masks449 cells/no wrap/interior; source/receiver metadata unchanged; zero baseline scatter error1; hashes stable. Physical paired response norm >1e-6 of nominal scatter norm.
plan.budget: 2 new physical and2 network calls plus cached interpolation, estimated<1minute,cap3minutes; separate verification may replay2+2. No training/download.

verification: Separate two physical and two neural replays allowed
execution: IEEE float32 forwards; float64 reference interpolation and metrics; sparse interpolated scatter cast float32 for existing reconstruction
